scores.rationale: Matched set of eight Victorian carved rosewood balloon-back chairs, later upholstery; sets of eight usually make a few hundred dollars.
Room-size Mir/Saraband style rug, no certificate, faded; realistic mix of hand-knotted and lesser/machine pieces, roughly $150-350.
Kenneth Jack style Elmore scene; most such pieces are prints, an original is uncertain, so blended value is modest.
Signed 1997 acrylic by known wildlife painter; modest but real market for framed original.
Geoff Dyer style river study but signature illegible; if genuine worth hundreds, discounted for attribution risk.
Inscribed and signed 1887 Higgs Jnr Mount Roland oil, colonial Tasmanian landscape; grime and condition issues but strong local demand.
Large 2023 signed work by working Tasmanian artist; big unframed abstract resells for a few hundred at best.
Colonial cedar Pembroke table c1840 with stringing; worn, warped leaves limit value to a few hundred.
Large Dutch colonial style chest with brass fittings, timber uncertain, scratched; decorator piece around $150-350.
Large cast iron urn on plinth, unmarked, flaking paint and rust; garden market likely $200-400.
